extension.summary: Install KingBlap Kodi builds across Kodi-supported platforms.
extension.description: Shows separate public and private KingBlap build choices for Kodi 21 Omega and Kodi 22 Piers. Kodi 21.3 and Kodi 22 public builds download directly from the public repository with SHA-256 verification; private builds download from the KingBlap service and require the saved 16-digit access code. Public builds omit saved add-on profile data; private builds may restore saved service credentials. Before downloading or unpacking, the Wizard checks that Kodi has enough free storage and stops with a clear message when the device needs space. Private installs pause IPTV while preparing large archives, record the original service state, and restore it after an interrupted install. It installs packaged add-ons, verifies every packaged add-on is enabled, supports GIPTV profiles with Kodi-managed IPTV Simple, asks Kodi to install device-compatible native dependencies, sets Gismeteo for Thomasville, removes duplicate legacy installers, OnePlay, and private-build OptiKlean, and applies the compatible Xonfluence skin. Private builds can install and select their packaged screensaver. Private GIPTV builds keep only USA and 24/7 playlist groups and stream a filtered guide for those channels. Their TV Channels window opens in Xonfluence Preview List. Private builds can apply a low-memory streaming-buffer limit and remove legacy add-ons they replace. It checks active skin files before preserving them and restores incomplete skin files during installation. Interrupted installs are recovered safely when Kodi starts again. Private builds can set Kodi to install compatible add-on updates automatically from enabled repositories.
extension.disclaimer: Public builds do not include saved add-on account profile data from the backup. Private builds may include service credentials saved in add-on profile data and require a shared access code. Review the selected build before installing it.
